mapper.sql: d.id, d.student_id, d.aid_type, d.level, d.amount, d.reason, d.evidence, d.status, d.approver_id, d.approve_note, d.academic_year, d.created_at, d.updated_at, d.deleted, d.poverty_level, d.review_stage, d.cert_year, d.publicity_start, d.publicity_end, d.objection_deadline, d.committee_note, d.report_note, d.recheck_result, d.rechecked_at, d.materials, d.family_note, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.nickname, u.username) AS student_name, COALESCE(sp.student_no, u.student_id) AS student_no, COALESCE(sp.class_name, u.class_name) AS class_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(a.real_name, ''), a.username) AS approver_name, IFNULL(sp.gender, '') AS gender

FROM aid_application d LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = d.student_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = d.student_id AND sp.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN users a ON a.id = d.approver_id

sql.if: AND (u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR sp.student_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR sp.class_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR d.reason LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO aid_application (student_id, aid_type, level, amount, reason, evidence, status, academic_year, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{aidType}, #{level}, #{amount}, #{reason}, #{evidence}, #{status}, #{academicYear}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aid_application d WHERE d.student_id = #{studentId} AND d.deleted = 0 AND d.aid_type != 'need' AND d.status = #{status}

SELECT COUNT(*)
WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND d.aid_type != 'need'
mapper.update: UPDATE aid_application SET status = #{to}, approver_id = #{approverId}, approve_note = #{approveNote}, updated_at = NOW() , amount = #{amount} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{from} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE aid_application SET status = 'cancelled', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND student_id = #{studentId} AND status = 'pending' AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO aid_application (student_id, aid_type, level, amount, reason, evidence, materials, family_note, status, academic_year, cert_year, review_stage, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{aidType}, #{level}, #{amount}, #{reason}, #{evidence}, #{materials}, #{familyNote}, #{status}, #{academicYear}, #{certYear}, #{reviewStage}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND d.student_id = #{studentId} AND d.aid_type IN ('need', '困难认定') ORDER BY d.created_at DESC, d.id DESC

SELECT d.review_stage AS review_stage, COUNT(*) AS cnt
WHERE d.deleted = 0
GROUP BY d.review_stage

SELECT
WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND d.aid_type IN ('need', '困难认定') AND d.review_stage IN ('publicity', 'objection') AND d.publicity_start IS NOT NULL AND d.status = 'pending' AND d.cert_year = #{certYear} ORDER BY FIELD(d.poverty_level, '特困', '贫困'), d.id

SELECT
WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND d.aid_type IN ('need', '困难认定') AND d.status = 'approved' AND d.cert_year = #{certYear} AND sp.counselor_id = #{scopeCounselorId} ORDER BY d.rechecked_at IS NULL DESC, d.id
mapper.update: UPDATE aid_application SET poverty_level = #{level}, approve_note = #{note}, review_stage = #{toStage}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND review_stage = #{fromStage}
UPDATE aid_application SET poverty_level = #{level}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE aid_application SET publicity_start = #{start}, publicity_end = #{end}, objection_deadline = #{end}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND review_stage = #{fromStage} AND publicity_start IS NULL
UPDATE aid_application SET approver_id = #{approverId}, approve_note = #{note}, review_stage = #{toStage}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND review_stage = #{fromStage}

UPDATE aid_application SET status = 'approved', approver_id = #{approverId}, approve_note = #{note}, poverty_level = #{level}, review_stage = 'approved', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND review_stage = #{fromStage}
UPDATE aid_application SET status = 'rejected', approve_note = #{note}, review_stage = 'rejected', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND review_stage = #{fromStage}

UPDATE aid_application SET recheck_result = #{result}, rechecked_at = NOW(), poverty_level = #{newLevel}, approve_note = #{note}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'approved' AND cert_year = #{certYear}
